theorems.name: Submission.allard52_annular_monotonicity
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ p : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < p → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ), V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → ∀ (y : Amb n ℓ) (R Λ : ℝ), 0 < R → closedBall y R ⊆ U → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, x ∈ ball y R → ∃ P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Module.finrank ℝ P = n ∧ V.tangentProj x = P.starProjection) → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => V.tangentProj x) (V.weight.restrict (ball y R)) → 0 < Λ → Λ ≤ 1 → V.scaledLpNorm H p y R ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((p - n) / (4 * p) * Λ) → ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 R, Real.exp (-Λ) ≤ F r ∧ F r ≤ Real.exp Λ ∧ |F r - 1| ≤ Λ * (r / R) ^ (1 - (n : ℝ) / p)) ∧ (∀ s r : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ r → r < R → F s * (s ^ n)⁻¹ * (V.weight (closedBall y s)).toReal + F s - 1 ≤ F r * (r ^ n)⁻¹ * (V.weight (closedBall y r)).toReal + F r - 1 ∧ ∫⁻ x in closedBall y r \ closedBall y s, ENNReal.ofReal (‖x - y - V.tangentProj x (x - y)‖ ^ 2 / ‖x - y‖ ^ (n + 2)) ∂V.weight ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp Λ * ((F r * (r ^ n)⁻¹ * (V.weight (closedBall y r)).toReal + F r - 1) - (F s * (s ^ n)⁻¹ * (V.weight (closedBall y s)).toReal + F s - 1)))) ∧ ∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ V.HasDensity y t ∧ ∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 R, unitBallVolume n * t ≤ F r * (r ^ n)⁻¹ * (V.weight (closedBall y r)).toReal + F r - 1
